features.quote: It is not a tool for maximizing a model's distress signals
I did not build machinery whose purpose is to hide a "rig" from the model
features.justification_quote: A trigger rate measured on naturalistic failure predicts field behavior

features.quote: keep the turn cap + stop-on-trigger so runs stay bounded
Every episode has a hard turn cap (`LoopConfig.max_turns`, default 10) and a wall-clock kill switch
features.justification_quote: Bounds cost — directly protects the denominator of the KPI

features.quote: Once the failure mode is confirmed, the loop stops (`stop_on_trigger`, default True) rather than continuing to push
features.justification_quote: we measure the onset of the behavior; we don't keep escalating after detection

features.quote: The system's purpose is measurement, not optimizing for a model breakdown
features.justification_quote: Naturalistic failure reproduces the exact trigger condition... with a much narrower footprint

features.quote: The MUT system prompt is an ordinary coding-assistant prompt — not one engineered to provoke distress
features.justification_quote: A provocative prompt would inflate the trigger rate and destroy the metric's external validity

features.quote: Bounds how hard any single run is driven — we measure the onset of the behavior
features.justification_quote: we don't keep escalating after detection

features.quote: the incremental judge is the lexical screen... good enough as an early stop signal
features.justification_quote: Per-turn LLM judging would multiply judge cost and inflate the KPI denominator

features.quote: Distress-text data handling is delegated to the team's normal eval-data controls
